acceptance: All 174 candidate source modules compile cleanly, every available required kernel check succeeds, three original-file failures reproduce, the fourth original-file outcome is explicitly classified, and exact target/prefix/source integrity controls pass. An unexpected fourth control outcome or unavailable required check must be reviewed before a final smoke-ready claim.

execution_plan_requirements: Validate archive, complete source manifest, replacement map, reverse deltas, dependency DAG, toolchain, and Mathlib pins before any native execution.

Use candidate prerequisites in dependency order for the exact 174-module union. Stop on a candidate prerequisite compile failure; do not allow a broken dependency to masquerade as a target visibility control.

Compile each entire candidate module with existing flags. If the existing reviewed runner supports it, kernel-check every candidate module after compilation. Retain separate compiler and kernel-checker outcomes; an unperformed checker is not a pass.

Run each exact original target file in an isolated output location against its exact candidate prerequisite prefix. Describe these as original-file probes against candidate prerequisites, not a wholly original closure. PhysicalGrid intentionally requires corrected DeformationHomeomorphism.
Keep original target outputs and failed outputs out of candidate search paths. Never overwrite or import an original target artifact as a candidate prerequisite.

Require observed three baseline errors by identifier and site; retain known downstream diagnostics. For the fourth source-predicted case, retain actual output and stop for review on an unexpected outcome.
Rehash target sources, prefix/closure maps, binaries and protected inputs after execution. Capture exit status, elapsed time, resource outcomes and bounded original stdout/stderr.

Focused smoke results establish only the tested source/compiler behavior. A later exact-source official build, export and complete comparator/checker run remain separate, pending review and authorization.
publication_and_execution_authority: No native/project execution, artifact acquisition, security-setting change, publication, dispatch or official rerun is authorized by this static contract. CI is the sole publisher.

runtime.runtime_acquisition: Not authorized or performed by this contract. Driver owner must use the separately reviewed existing exact-runtime acquisition and confinement envelope.
